name: Justin Thurman
why: A full studio portrait, not a halftone crop: the 2010 issue is born digital, so this is the photograph at its own resolution. It is one of the pair the Herald ran across the top of the front page when the presidential candidates faced off, each frame separately captioned with one name in capitals beneath it. Thurman is the right-hand frame. The subject is in profile rather than front on, which is how the paper shot the pair so they faced each other.

src.label: College Heights Herald, Vol. 85, No. 39, 23 March 2010, p. 1

name: Stacey Taylor
why: Cropped from the two-shot that runs across the gutter of the Herald's feature on the Taylor twins. Identified by position, which the caption states rather than leaves to be inferred: Stacey, left, and Natalie. She is the smiling woman on the left, with a clip in her hair. That the twins are the SGA members is settled by the story itself, which lists student government among the activities the sisters shared. Because the photograph is a double truck, the frame had to be rebuilt from the two page scans and a white line from the paper's gutter runs down the left of her face.
caption_quote: Stacey, left, and Natalie, joke together during church choir practice

src.label: College Heights Herald, Vol. 76, No. 54, 24 April 2001, pp. 10-11

name: Natalie Taylor
why: The right-hand half of the same two-shot, the woman in glasses. Identified the same way, by the caption's own statement of who is where. Strict profile, because she is turned to face her sister, but sharp and large on the page. Her sister is identical, so the caption is the identification and nothing else could be.
caption_quote: Stacey, left, and Natalie, joke together during church choir practice

name: Angelika Masero
why: A colour headshot on WKU's own news page about the seven students the Fulbright programme honoured in 2014. It sits directly above the paragraph that names her, and the file itself is named for her. Taken four years after her SGA year and small at the size WKU published it, but it is a single subject, front on and in focus, and no photograph of her from her time in office has been found. The page does not mention SGA; it identifies her as a 2010 graduate of WKU and the Honors College in journalism and German, which is the same person as the worklist's 2009-10 Director of Public Relations. The surname is rare, the archive holds only one Masero, and a journalism student writing for the Herald from 2005 and graduating in 2010 fits the SGA officer exactly. An editor who wants the link stated on a WKU page rather than inferred should treat this as the one open question about the finding.
caption_quote: Angelika Masero, daughter of Areti Baldwin, is a 2010 graduate of WKU and the Honors College at WKU

src.label: WKU Ogden College news, Seven students honored by Fulbright program, 22 May 2014

name: Elizabeth White
why: Her senate candidate mugshot in the Herald's 2005 election special, with her name set in bold beneath the frame. The archive records Elizabeth White as a senator in 2004-05 and Lizzy White as a senator in 2005-06, and the story beside this photograph is what ties them together: it calls her a Nashville sophomore and says this is her second semester in the Student Government Association, which puts her first semester in the autumn of 2004. Lizzy is the ordinary short form of Elizabeth, and one White joining SGA in 2004-05 is far likelier than two. Small at the scan's native resolution but sharp and front on. See the note file: the two rows are very probably one person entered twice, which is an editorial question about the roster rather than about this photograph.

src.label: College Heights Herald, SGA election special, 15 March 2005, p. 3C

name: Brittany Fausey
why: Her studio portrait from the Spirit Masters display board for the class of 2004-05, photographed into the group's scrapbook in the WKU Archives. The board pastes the members' headshots in a V and writes each person's name, year, major and home town beside their own frame, in alphabetical order down one arm and up the other: Farrell, Fausey, Griffin, Hale, Hodson, Inman, Jones, LeGrand, Lovan, Manning. Fausey's label sits to the left of her frame rather than the right, because Walker Hale's frame takes the space on that side, and the alphabetical chain fixes which frame is hers. Everything on the label matches what the Herald printed about her in March 2004: senior, corporate and organisational communication, Jeffersonville, Indiana, and a Spirit Master. A proper colour studio headshot, the best frame of anyone in this block.
caption_quote: Brittany Fausey Senior Corporate + Organizational Communication Jeffersonville, IN

name: Evelina V. Petkova
why: Not a worklist name for this block, but a clear upgrade found while working it. She currently carries a 159 by 226 newsprint halftone cut from the 2004 Herald election section. This is a colour studio headshot from the Spirit Masters display board for the class of 2004-05, photographed into the group's scrapbook in the WKU Archives. Identification is by the board's own layout: the frames run in a V, each with its owner's handwritten name, year, major and home town beside it, and on the descending arm the label is written to the right of its frame. Hers reads Evelina Petkova, Senior, Marketing, Sofia, Bulgaria, and is written immediately to the right of this frame, between it and the next in the chain. Drop this entry if the editor would rather keep the newsprint frame.
caption_quote: Evelina Petkova Senior Marketing Sofia, Bulgaria
